summary: Issue 4 — Temporary Material. Page 1: Delayed Part. The replacement-bracket problem begins as an ordinary maintenance problem, not a material discovery.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Maintenance bay. A coolant-balancing unit is open in the wall. A red status strip is visible.
PANEL 2 — Zib studies a cracked stabilizer bracket.
PANEL 3 — Astra enters with coffee and three unrelated forms.
PANEL 4 — Zib points into the housing.
PANEL 5 — Procurement display shows the replacement-part delay.

dialogueInline.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogueInline.text: TEMPORARY FLOW INSTABILITY — NON-CATASTROPHIC BUT ANNOYING.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Tell me this is normal annoying.

summary: Page 2: Nineteen Days. Astra assigns Jax the concrete monitoring job while temporary-repair bureaucracy arrives.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra reads the ETA twice.
PANEL 2 — Zib keeps working.
PANEL 3 — Astra does not look up.
PANEL 4 — Jax arrives with a handheld flow reader.
PANEL 5 — Astra points at the unit. Jax looks at the reader, then the unit, and accepts that this is now his morning.
PANEL 6 — Pixa projects a temporary-material-usage form.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We are not doing procurement fraud before lunch.

dialogueInline.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogueInline.text: TEMPORARY MATERIAL USAGE REQUEST — JUSTIFY DEVIATION FROM IDEAL REALITY.

summary: Page 3: One Sample. Mira notices a physical difference between retained residue samples without assigning meaning to it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira works at a nearby lab bench with sealed samples retained from prior incidents. Labels are physical and cautious.
PANEL 2 — She presses a brittle fragment with a probe. It crumbles.
PANEL 3 — She taps a denser fragment against a steel test block. It clicks instead of flaking.
PANEL 4 — Mira stops.
PANEL 5 — Zib glances over from the wall.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks at the fragment, genuinely uncertain.

summary: Page 4: Control First. The first result is deliberately small: one sample crumbles and one does not.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira repeats the same simple compression test on both samples.
PANEL 2 — She records the result.
PANEL 3 — Zib stares at her.
PANEL 4 — Mira holds up the two samples.
PANEL 5 — Astra nods.
PANEL 6 — Mira immediately qualifies it.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Same residue class. Different post-formation cohesion.

summary: Page 5: Temporary Means Owner. Glorp and Kreeb reduce temporary-repair procedure to owner, expiry, and inspection while Jax takes the readings.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp reviews the temporary repair authorization with visible alarm.
PANEL 2 — Glorp taps the word TEMPORARY.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb reads beside them.
PANEL 4 — Zib speaks from inside the wall compartment.
PANEL 5 — Glorp reluctantly reduces the procedure to three required fields.
PANEL 6 — Jax raises the flow reader. Astra nods once. No ceremony.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Temporary systems become permanent through exhaustion.

summary: Page 6: Bench Test. Mira and Zib try to make the sample fail safely before allowing it near station infrastructure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira and Zib build a small off-line test rig. Nothing touches station infrastructure yet.
PANEL 2 — Mira sets the sequence.
PANEL 3 — Zib watches her deliberately abuse the sample.
PANEL 4 — Mira does not look up.
PANEL 5 — The fragment survives heat and compression, then chips under sustained vibration.
PANEL 6 — Zib points at the damaged sample.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Heat first. Compression second. Then vibration.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: You say that like you want it to fail.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I want it to fail here.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: So it is not a bracket.

summary: Page 7: First Patch. The residue is used only as gap filler inside a conventional temporary brace; the approved clamp carries the load.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib builds a conventional temporary brace from approved clamp hardware and mesh. The residue fragment is used only as gap-filling material inside the brace.
PANEL 2 — Astra watches closely.
PANEL 3 — Zib tightens the approved clamp.
PANEL 4 — Mira checks the configuration.
PANEL 5 — The unit restarts. Status changes on the display.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Say exactly what it is doing.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Filling a gap. Clamp carries the load.

summary: Page 8: Watch the Number. Jax stays on the boring monitoring task and catches a small shift before it becomes a larger problem.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax watches the handheld reader beside the unit.
PANEL 2 — He logs the first interval.
PANEL 3 — Astra checks the temporary tag.
PANEL 4 — Jax shows her the handwritten schedule.
PANEL 5 — At the next reading, Jax notices a slight shift before anyone else does.
PANEL 6 — Zib isolates the unit immediately.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I know. That is why I wrote ten.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I was hoping you would say "nothing."

summary: Page 9: Second Patch. Zib increases conventional reinforcement and reduces the weird material; Pixa reports only the physical result.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the brace again.
PANEL 2 — He adds more approved mesh and reduces the amount of residue filler.
PANEL 3 — Mira agrees.
PANEL 4 — Jax holds the reader ready while Astra keeps the temporary authorization visible at the workbench.
PANEL 5 — Zib restarts the unit.
PANEL 6 — Pixa displays only the physical result.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That is also my preferred ratio.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Flow variance reduced by eighteen percent.

summary: Page 10: It Works At All. The crew permits exactly one conclusion: the filler did not get in the way of a conventional clamp surviving two cycles.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The unit completes another cycle.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the patch.
PANEL 3 — Zib refuses to over-credit it.
PANEL 4 — Mira smiles despite herself.
PANEL 5 — Astra hears the phrase from across the bay.
PANEL 6 — Brick, already present, writes in his notebook.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: The clamp survived. The filler did not get in the way.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Nobody says "commercial" until I am dead.

dialogueInline.speaker: TEXT
dialogueInline.text: THE WEIRD THING GOT A JOB.

summary: Page 11: What We Know. Mira's small results board creates the unavoidable reporting question.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira builds a small results board: heat exposure, compression, vibration damage, installed configuration.
PANEL 2 — She looks at Astra.
PANEL 3 — Astra relaxes slightly.
PANEL 4 — Mira points toward the temporary repair form.
PANEL 5 — She shows the reporting requirement.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes her eyes.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: You will hate the next part.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Safety record requires the material event.

summary: Page 12: Report Required. Traceability wins: if the material touched a system, its history has to be accurate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp traces the temporary-deviation reporting path on a tablet.
PANEL 2 — Glorp looks up.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb answers calmly.
PANEL 4 — Astra points at the report destination.
PANEL 5 — Glorp shakes their head.
PANEL 6 — Zib shuts the wall panel.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: If it touched a system, it has a history.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Nobody made the reporting tree. It grew.

summary: Page 13: The Argument. Mira wants an accurate report; Astra fears one patch will be institutionalized as a discovery.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira stand across the workbench. Neither is angry. Both understand the stakes.
PANEL 2 — Mira keeps her voice level.
PANEL 3 — Astra answers just as quietly.
PANEL 4 — Astra points to the single patched unit.
PANEL 5 — Mira meets her gaze.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: If this matters, we should report it correctly.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: If this matters, we should survive reporting it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: And turning one patch into a discovery is not science.

summary: Page 14: The Real Fear. Astra names the institutional chain she fears: anomaly to category to target to budget to production pressure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira studies Astra instead of the sample.
PANEL 2 — Astra gestures toward the report.
PANEL 3 — She continues.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks around the station.
PANEL 5 — Mira answers the part Astra cannot dismiss.
PANEL 6 — Astra nods.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A useful anomaly gets a category.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A category gets a target. A target gets a budget.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Then the budget tells us how to make more of it.

summary: Page 15: Stop Arguing Like a Meeting. Zib makes Astra and Mira continue the decision while physically finishing the job.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib, still trying to finish the actual repair, interrupts them.
PANEL 2 — Astra turns.
PANEL 3 — Zib hands Astra part of the brace.
PANEL 4 — He gives Mira the sensor lead. The three of them resume work.
PANEL 5 — Mira keeps talking while checking the sensor.
PANEL 6 — Astra holds the brace steady.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Then make it while holding this.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I can write only what the test supports.

summary: Page 16: Bounded Language. The report states the ugly practical use and its limits without turning it into a mechanism.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp, Kreeb, Mira, and Astra work around one terminal rather than holding another meeting.
PANEL 2 — The report shows the narrow temporary-use finding and its limits.
PANEL 3 — Glorp studies it.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb nods.
PANEL 5 — Astra reads the sentence again.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks toward the patched unit.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Incidental residue contributed to temporary gap filling under monitored conditions. Structural load remained on approved clamp. Repeatability unknown.

summary: Page 17: Signature. Jax completes his monitoring log; Astra signs and sends only the narrow version because there is no defensible broad version.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax arrives with the completed monitoring log.
PANEL 2 — He hands it to Astra.
PANEL 3 — Astra checks the intervals.
PANEL 4 — Jax shrugs.
PANEL 5 — The report waits on the station manager signature.
PANEL 6 — Astra signs.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Four cycles. Still inside temporary limits.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: It kept asking for numbers, so I gave it numbers.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: There is only a narrow version.

summary: Page 18: Monitor Shift. Jax stays through the next reading because the task is his, not because anyone is watching him do it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Later. The maintenance bay is quiet. Jax remains beside the reader for the next scheduled interval.
PANEL 2 — Zib passes through.
PANEL 3 — Jax checks the clock.
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at him, mildly surprised.
PANEL 5 — Jax does not look up.
PANEL 6 — The gauge stays within the temporary band.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I know. The next reading is in six minutes.

summary: Page 19: Send. Astra and Mira remove any language stronger than the evidence before Astra sends the report herself.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira perform the final read together.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at a modifier.
PANEL 3 — Mira edits it.
PANEL 4 — Astra checks the causal language.
PANEL 5 — Mira does not touch the screen.
PANEL 6 — Astra hits SEND herself.

summary: Page 20: Acknowledged. The bounded report is immediately forwarded to Resource Efficiency Review, proving Astra's fear institutionally rather than scientifically.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A notification arrives almost immediately.
PANEL 2 — Astra exhales.
PANEL 3 — A second line appears.
PANEL 4 — Astra's expression changes.
PANEL 5 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 6 — Brick closes his notebook.

summary: Page 21: Still Temporary. The repair remains monitored and temporary even as the station receives its first value flag.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Next cycle. The repaired unit hums. The temporary tag is still prominent.
PANEL 2 — Zib checks procurement.
PANEL 3 — Astra points at the patch.
PANEL 4 — Zib closes the panel.
PANEL 5 — Mira seals another physical sample.
PANEL 6 — Pixa's screen lights. Nobody speaks.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Everything is temporary if procurement is involved.

summary: Page 22: Tag — Value Identified. Astra and Mira agree the report was necessary even as commercial-interest machinery arrives immediately.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra's terminal expands the notification.
PANEL 2 — A smaller line appears beneath it.
PANEL 3 — Astra stares at the wording.
PANEL 4 — Mira remains beside her.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks through the glass toward the functioning maintenance bay.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: THANK YOU FOR YOUR CONTRIBUTION TO STATION VALUE IDENTIFICATION.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I still think we had to report it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I just wanted one more day before it got a department.
